name: multisetProd_apply_eq_zero'
statement: Multiset ((⨁ i, A i) × ι)} (hs : ∀ xn ∈ s, ∀ k < xn.2, xn.1 k = 0) ⦃n : ι⦄ (hn : n < (s.map Prod.snd).sum) : (s.map Prod.fst).prod n = 0

name: multisetProd_apply_eq_zero
statement: Multiset (⨁ i, A i)} {m : ι} (hs : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ k < m, x k = 0) ⦃n : ι⦄ (hn : n < s.card • m) : s.prod n = 0
